verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on 2 Chronicles 35

Passover on 14/I (Hezekiah's had been in the second month); 30,000 small cattle and 3,000 bulls from the king; Selman: total more than double Hezekiah's; Levites slaughtered the lambs; Necho "came up to fight against Carchemish" in support of Assyria; Josiah's opposition was in support of Assyria (Morgan); Payne: the battle at Megiddo has "archaeological confirmation" in Stratum II (not verified here); Selman: Josiah's death paralleled with Ahab's; Payne: the "Laments" are a lost book, not the canonical Lamentations
